summary: Task 4 cleanly extracts a public preview_nodes wrapper from publish_article. The refactor goes a step further than required — publish_article now delegates to preview_nodes, making the new helper the single source of truth for node-tree construction and eliminating any risk of preview/publish drift. All acceptance criteria met; 12 new tests cover parity, offline invariant, token-independence, and title-not-leaked contract.

suggestions.suggestion: The `title` parameter is accepted but unused inside preview_nodes. This is explicitly by design (symmetry with publish_article, title is a separate Telegraph API field) and is documented in the docstring — noted for transparency, no action required.
suggestions.benefit: None — behaviour matches task spec item 4 and is verified by test_title_not_in_nodes.
